notes: Edit this file to change what TOFC Bot says in Ticket Tool tickets. You do not need to change any code. entries[].answer is the exact text the bot may send. phrases are words or phrases that must show up in the member's message; weight is how strongly each one counts (a score of 3 or more, and clearly ahead of every other entry, is a confident match). coversHandoff lets that entry answer even if the question also sounds like a handoff topic. Confirmed Whop prices and checkout links live only in the whop-prices entry. handoffTopics still catch refunds, discount codes, and who won. The todos list is for Brandon only — the bot never reads it to members. Do not add a refund policy, affiliate URL, or winner until it is confirmed. On Railway this file ships inside the image, so commit the edit and redeploy. Locally it reloads on the next ticket message when the file changes.

entries.question: What do Premium members get?
entries.answer: Premium members get the daily NQ GEX levels posted every trading day before the New York open (15:30 Amsterdam time), plus the education course.

entries.question: What is the education course?
entries.answer: The education course on Whop is "Master TOFC Models": about 6 hours of video in 14 chapters — Introduction, DeepCharts Setup, Checklist & No trade days, Price Action (Context), AMT (Location), Orderflow (Confirmation), TOFC Model 1 to 6, Domino effect models, END. Each model has a visual, an explanation video, a case study and a quiz. TOFC charts on DeepCharts.

entries.question: How do invite rewards work?
entries.answer: Invite 10 people who stay in the server 14+ days (accounts 30+ days old) to get 50% off your first month of Premium. If someone buys through your Whop affiliate link, you get one month of Premium free. Claim it by opening a ticket and choosing "🎁 Claim invite reward". This bot does not send reward codes.

entries.question: How does Trader of the Month work?
entries.answer: Trader of the Month uses points each month: a payout is 4, a funded account is 2, and a winning day is 1. Sim/demo does not count. The winner gets a free month of Premium, announced on the 1st in 〔🏆〕tofc-best-weekly-traders.

entries.question: When are weekly best traders highlighted?
entries.answer: Weekly best traders are highlighted every Friday in 〔🏆〕tofc-best-weekly-traders.

entries.question: Which levels do you trade from: VAH/VAL/POC, overnight or daily?
entries.answer: VAH, VAL and POC are the best areas to trade from. The overnight VAH, VAL and POC are where we look for trades. 'Previous' means the previous fair value areas, used as reference. For the models, the cash session levels matter most.

entries.question: Which session do you trade: NY, London or Asia?
entries.answer: New York AM, the cash session, works best. The other sessions have more manipulation, so Chromey rarely trades outside New York. If you trade overnight, use the previous New York session data as your baseline.

entries.question: Which prop firm do you use / recommend, and how do I pass an eval?
entries.answer: What Chromey currently uses and recommends is Lucid. It pays out fast, and you can keep trading after you request a payout (rules differ per prop firm). A good start is a Lucid 25k eval with MotiveWave, which is free with an active Lucid account. To pass evals, learn the TOFC models and check Chromey's YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Chromeymono

entries.question: How many contracts / what risk rules do you use?
entries.answer: Mostly micros. Set your daily risk limit at the broker so you can't blow more than you planned. After a loss, wait half an hour before the next trade. If you chart NQ and execute on MNQ, make sure both are rolled over to the same contract.

entries.question: What do CVD, delta and the bubbles tell me?
entries.answer: The bubbles (deep trades) show executed market orders, not resting limit orders. Heavy aggressive buying at a candle high with no continuation can mean absorption. Volume is more useful than delta: high buy volume means a higher chance of slicing through a level. CVD is good for seeing delta pressure and divergence, so check it at your POIs. Don't cut the ask & bid from your footprint, that's the best info.

entries.question: Where can I learn orderflow / AMT / footprint? Any videos you recommend?
entries.answer: Best place is our own material: the Master TOFC Models course on Whop (included with Premium) covers the full TOFC system, orderflow, AMT and price action. For free content, check Chromey's YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@Chromeymono) and join the free Wednesday community lesson at 11:00 AM New York time.

entries.question: Which GEX levels do you use / mark?
entries.answer: Check the daily market review and the daily GEX post; that's the pre-plan. If you scalp, use the intraday 0DTE levels. EOD levels are for higher-timeframe traders. Intraday 0DTE data is only there once New York opens.

entries.question: Do I get all the TOFC models with Premium? Is there a PDF / documentation?
entries.answer: Yes. Premium (Prestige One) gives you access to all TOFC models with full documentation, the Master TOFC Models course on Whop, the DeepCharts templates and Chromey's premarket plan. There are no trade callouts or signals: we teach you the system so you can trade it yourself.

entries.question: When are the live lessons / community calls, and how do I join?
entries.answer: Every Wednesday is community day: a free live lesson at 11:00 AM New York time, right after trading hours, where we go over the day and the TOFC models. Join through the Discord event in the server (details are pinned). On Fridays there's a community lesson too, for example psychology with nq.brandon. Chromey also streams on Kick: https://kick.com/chromemono

entries.question: How many models are there and when is a model valid?
entries.answer: The course covers TOFC Model 1 to 6 plus the Domino Effect Models. Each model has a visual, an explanation video, a case study and a quiz. Example: Model 1 needs price to tap into the POC, then break and retest from the value area. If price never touched the POC, it's lower probability. Not sure a setup is valid? Post a screenshot in the chat.

entries.question: Which orderflow platform should I use? Is DeepCharts required?
entries.answer:
Most of us use DeepCharts. It's the easiest orderflow tool and Chromey's personal favorite. Get it through our partner link for the max discount: https://my.deepcharts.com/redirect/deepchart?affId=TOFC
Alternatives: ATAS, Sierra Chart (best if you want to build your own settings), Quantower, and Bookmap for an order heatmap. MotiveWave is free with an active Lucid (Rithmic) account.

entries.question: Can DeepCharts connect to Tradovate / trade prop firms directly, or only Rithmic?
entries.answer: DeepCharts connects through Rithmic only, so not Tradovate. If your account is on Tradovate, you can buy CME market data for DeepCharts separately. More DeepCharts questions? Hop in a call and we'll help you.

entries.question: When do you not trade? Which market conditions do you avoid?
entries.answer: Avoid low-volatility days and balanced markets where the balance range is under 100 pips, or when optionsflow is balanced (calls and puts at the same values). Also be careful around opex and news (CPI, PPI, FOMC). There's a lot of manipulation then. When it's unclear, skip it or keep risk small.

entries.question: Where do I find the DeepCharts settings / templates?
entries.answer: There's a setup video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qMkcdf_BcEo. The full TOFC DeepCharts templates are in the Premium group. To load them, put the template file in the right folder first, then add the "Deep Profile" indicator and choose the indicator template.

entries.question: Is there a DeepCharts discount / code?
entries.answer: Yes, we're partnered with DeepCharts. Use our partner link for the max discount: https://my.deepcharts.com/redirect/deepchart?affId=TOFC

entries.question: Do you give signals / callouts, or can I copy your trades?
entries.answer: No. TOFC doesn't do trade callouts or signals, Premium included. TOFC is about independence: if you want to copy trades, this isn't the community for you. We teach you everything you need to trade today's market with orderflow and price action, so you can trade the TOFC models yourself.

entries.question: How long does it take to learn orderflow?
entries.answer: It seems harder than it is. Orderflow is an extra toolkit on top of price action. Mark out the 15–30 min opening range and confirm those zones with orderflow. The Master TOFC Models course takes you through it step by step.
